'''2012 Bespin Regionals Nick Rambo DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Rambo]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
